designs.name: Ship 01 · Retro saucer
designs.notes: Choose any terrain-inspired paint scheme, greyscale or your own custom colours. Paint is independent of the race terrain: every scheme is available everywhere. Use Custom colours to change body, wings, cockpit, underside and rim / exhaust separately.

designs.name: Ship 02 · Industrial tug
designs.notes: Long armoured hull and large rear engine, with separate pods on swept, tapered airfoil supports. Clean cel shading, greyscale default and independent paint choices.

designs.name: Ship 03 · Orbital racer
designs.notes: An upright ring around a compact cockpit hub, long forward boom and two opposite pod stations joined by broad swept supports. Greyscale cel shading, all terrain-inspired palettes and custom colours, independent of terrain.

designs.name: Ship 04 · Splitwing
designs.notes: Upright swept wings around a shorter bevelled hull, tapered toward the nose. Single cockpit and one centred rear jet, with all paint options available.

designs.name: Ship 05 · Twinfin
designs.notes: Three bevelled blocks arranged front to back: a large front body, a flat middle neck and a broad rear block one-sixth the front block’s length. Wings and flaps share one shade. Twin rear engines and all paint options.

designs.name: Ship 06 · Longtail
designs.notes: Long tapered nose, slim raised cockpit and rear-weighted delta wings, with short forward canards and a single capped rear engine. Greyscale cel shading plus every terrain-inspired palette and custom colours.

designs.name: Ship 07 · Twinjet
designs.notes: A broad split nose, raised cockpit, twin cylindrical nacelles with recessed intakes, and wide swept wings. Greyscale, independent world palettes and custom paint controls.

designs.name: Ship 08 · Trijet
designs.notes: Three extended forward prongs surround a shortened central body. Darker swept connectors, an aft cockpit clear of the upper support, and one rear exhaust per prong. Independent paint palettes; now available in the game.

replacementPolicy: The studio contains the new authored collection. New studies enter the game fleet after review.
